sections.h2: Where Trenton exteriors break down first
body: A house rarely fails evenly. On Trenton homes we see the same pattern: the lowest stretch of siding never quite dries thanks to rain splash and lawn sprinklers, the sunny west- and south-facing sides lose pigment years ahead of the north side, and trim joints open up as the wood swells and dries. Close to Hart Springs and along the Suwannee, shade adds algae and mildew to that list.

So rather than charging a flat per-square-foot price across the house, our crew lead photographs each side on the visit and records the repairs and product picks wall by wall. That is the core of exterior painting in Trenton FL done right.

sections.h2: The coating system, surface by surface
bullets: Wood and fiber-cement siding, trim: two coats of premium 100% acrylic
Stucco with hairline movement: a flexible elastomeric film that spans fine cracks
Front doors, porch rails, and stair rails: a waterborne urethane enamel
Exposed wood: penetrating stain instead of film-forming paint
Brick and masonry: a coating suited to the substrate, named on the estimate

body: Prep has its own days on the Trenton schedule. The crew washes, scrapes loose paint until what remains is tight, sands, treats mildew, swaps out rotted wood and fascia, runs new caulk, and primes any bare wood. Where the coating needs to be worked into the surface, a second painter back-brushes or back-rolls behind the sprayer. Expect three to seven working days on the house itself, with washing and drying time on top.

Paint dries most predictably here between October and May. A summer job in Trenton begins soon after daybreak, with the crew lead watching the dew point and the radar and packing up ahead of the afternoon thunderstorms.

Where a Trenton house sits changes the plan. On a downtown lot, neighbors, vehicles, and sidewalks are close, so we bag shrubs, cover drives, and choose between spraying and rolling based on wind and clearance. Out on open homestead land, there is room to spray, but the sun hits every wall hard, so the sun-beaten south and west faces get the closest look, and we may suggest stepping up to a premium tier of paint just on those walls. Because each wall is its own line on the quote, a targeted upgrade like that is easy to see and approve.

The outside of your Trenton home is backed by our written workmanship warranty for as long as 10 years, separate from and on top of the paint maker's warranty, and labelled leftover paint stays with you. Washing is already part of prep, though our soft washing in Trenton page explains it in more detail. Homeowners doing inside and out together should look at full residential repaints in Trenton. For the bigger picture, see the exterior painting service page, the Trenton area page, or our article on how long exterior paint lasts in Florida.

faqs.q: Do you paint stucco and block homes in Trenton?
faqs.a: Yes. If the stucco shows fine moving cracks, we coat it in elastomeric, and larger cracks get repaired properly before any coating goes on.

faqs.q: Will you take on a Trenton exterior during the summer?
faqs.a: Yes, carefully. Crews start early, check dew point and the radar through the day, and still recommend October to May when your timeline allows.

faqs.q: How long is a Trenton exterior paint job warrantied?
faqs.a: Up to 10 years under our written workmanship warranty, and the manufacturer's own product warranty applies as well.

faqs.q: Do I need to pressure wash before you arrive?
faqs.a: No. We clean the house and treat mildew ourselves as the first prep step, and both are listed on your quote.
